content: GX-PARSER-041 The transcript parser exceeded its deadline while scanning an enormous conversation archive.
GX-DELEGATE-052 A child agent received the bounded investigation and returned evidence to its parent.
GX-POSTGRES-063 The database connection pool was exhausted during peak traffic and requests queued.
GX-ROTATE-074 Rotate the exposed access credential, revoke the previous key, and verify dependent services.
GX-CACHE-085 Rebuild the stale search index and validate that lookup results reflect current records.
GX-BUDGET-096 The context bundle exceeded the model limit, so it was compressed into a smaller evidence-backed handoff.
